exposure: obstetricians practising in public and private hospitals
outcome: Predictors of poor adherence to infection prevention bundle
cohort: Obstetricians and obstetric Diplomates in Australia
finding: Adherence to an infection prevention bundle at caesarean section was low among Australian obstetricians, with those practicing in private hospitals, those practicing in both public and private hospitals, Diplomates, and those not usually implementing a surgical safety checklist being more likely to have poor adherence.
